intent: Show the three-stage segmentation pipeline from micrograph to mask
stages: Encode | show the Feature extractor and Bad "Quote" Ent encoding the micrograph into a latent tensor || Fuse | show the Fusion module merging the latent tensor with positional embeddings || Decode | show the Decoder head rendering the segmentation mask
